Helena Anchev, also known as Orin's Mother Helena, is the daughter of  Sarevok Anchev and both the mother and half-sister to  Orin the Red, the latter of whom was born through an incestuous relationship between Sarevok and Helena.

Involvement

The corpse of Orin's Mother Helena is found in The Chosen's Room in the Bhaal Temple at X: 96 Y: 991 during ⁠Get Orin's Netherstone.

Using  Speak with Dead, Helena reveals that Sarevok Anchev ordered her to kill Orin as a offering to Lord Bhaal. Desperately needing Sarevok's approval and wanting to become Bhaal's chosen, Helena attacked Orin when she was only seven years old, but Orin retaliated and killed Helena instead. Helena's corpse was then put on display in Orin's room.

With this information it is possible to prevent Orin from killing whomever she ⁠kidnapped, without passing any ability checks.

Speak with Dead

Helena can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      Helena... Anchev... daughter... of... Sarevok...
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      Mother... of... Orin...
      • Why did you try to kill your own daughter?
        • Orin’s Mother Helena
          I... wanted... to be... Bhaal’s... Chosen...
        • Orin’s Mother Helena
          Sarevok... told me... she... must be... my... offering...
        • Orin’s Mother Helena
          I... was... close... my hand... around... her throat...
        • Orin’s Mother Helena
          I... failed...
          • Did Orin know that Sarevok ordered you to kill her?
            • Orin’s Mother Helena
              No... she... worshipped... him... loved... him...
            • Orin’s Mother Helena
              So... did... I...
  • Who killed you?
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      Orin... my... daughter...
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      I tried... to kill... her... but she... killed me... first...
  • What happened to you?
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      Orin... my... daughter...
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      I tried... to kill... her... but she... killed me... first...
  • Where are you from?
    • Orin’s Mother Helena
      Baldur’s... Gate... Brampton... district...
  • Why were you put on display like this?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*

Notes and references

  1. ↑ While Helena is listed as human on her character sheet, a  memoir written by  Sarevok Anchev describes her as a "shapeshifting beauty", implying that she, like Orin, was a changeling or part doppelganger.
